objective: Prove that direct-renderer coordinator calls use frozen e33 and exact disclosed source_inspector child calls use frozen rejected S5 before any further optimizer authorization.

cause.observed_failure: All successful direct-renderer route events were labeled coordinator and sent to e33, including child branches whose trainer tokens were evaluated under S5.
cause.repair: Token-native exact specialist-child prefix recognition plus explicit route evidence and aggregate raw/effective/call/event reconciliation.

p0_calibration.purpose: Measure true same-policy trainer/inference mismatch, termination, and reward behavior on the repaired route while retaining direct comparability to S6.
p0_calibration.output_policy: new write-once path; never resume or overwrite S6
required_route_evidence: raw trace identities equal effective trace identities
exact aggregate call and route multiplicity
every child route has exact_specialist_child_prefix, expert_id=source_inspector, and S5 upstream
every coordinator route has coordinator_without_specialist_child_prefix and e33 upstream
exactly 16 forced coordinator assignments and 16 rollout-scoped sessions
p0_calibration.disposition: Archive measurements and stop. P0 can never produce a checkpoint or authorize an update.

p1_admission_audit.purpose: Fresh-path LR=0 mechanism admission after P0 thresholds are independently frozen.
required_before_launch: root verifies the frozen fresh seed 20270917 and offset 71000
root freezes full 64-task P1 bank/key hashes after verifying disjointness from the full 64-task P0 bank
root freezes execution, Verifiers, config, and sampling hashes before launch
P1 uses a new write-once output and audit path
p1_admission_audit.failure_action: Stop without checkpoint, update, evaluation, or gate change.

future_update_boundary: A nonzero optimizer step requires a separate prospective plan and explicit root authorization after P1 passes. Neither P0 nor this plan authorizes it.

resources.layout: GPU0 LR=0 full-dense forward/backward mechanism probe; GPU1 S5 policy inference plus frozen e33 anchor
resources.concurrency: one calibration or audit stage at a time
